title: Pot Tracker
description: See how many healing pots your opponent has left — a configurable pot counter that follows the last player you hit.
body:
## Description

**PotTracker** is a lightweight, client‑side PvP utility that keeps count of your opponent's potions for you.

The moment you hit a player, they become your tracked target and a clean HUD readout shows how many pots they have left. Every splash (and optionally lingering) potion that player throws is subtracted from a configurable starting amount, so you always know roughly how many heals they have in the tank. Walk away and the counter quietly disappears once they leave your range; come back and it returns. Land a hit on someone else and the tracker instantly switches to the new target.

No server‑side mod, no commands — just install it and play.

### Features
- 🎯 **Auto‑targeting** — the last player you hit is tracked automatically.
- 🧪 **Live pot counting** — counts thrown splash/lingering potions and subtracts from a starting count you choose.
- 📏 **Range‑aware** — the HUD hides when the target gets farther than your configured forget‑distance (default 5 blocks) and reappears when you close back in.
- 🟥 **Low‑pot alert** — the counter turns to an alert colour (and can blink) once the target is running low.
- 🎨 **Fully customisable HUD** — position, alignment, colours, background box, opacity, text shadow, one‑ or two‑line layout, and more.
- 🔔 **Optional feedback** — chat messages on a new target / on every pot used, and a sound cue when the target heals.
- ⚙️ **30+ settings**, all in a tidy multi‑page Mod Menu screen.

### Settings (all in Mod Menu)
- **General** — enable, starting pot count, forget distance, throw‑detection radius, count splash, count lingering, auto‑clear timeout
- **Display** — keep showing at 0, show name, show count, show "pots" label, name on separate line, text shadow, alignment
- **Position & text colour** — HUD X / Y, text RGB
- **Low‑pot alert** — alert threshold, alert RGB, blink when low
- **Background** — box on/off, padding, opacity, background RGB
- **Alerts** — chat on new target, chat on pot used, sound on pot used

### Supported versions (Fabric)
- 1.21
- 1.21.1
- 1.21.4
- 1.21.8
- 1.21.11
- 26.1
- 26.1.1
- 26.1.2

### Requirements
- **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API**
- **Mod Menu** (optional, recommended) — used to open the settings screen.

> Client‑side only. Settings are saved to `config/pottracker.json`.

---

## Notes
Pot detection is heuristic: a thrown potion is credited to the nearest player at the moment it appears, and your own throws are ignored. The starting count is an estimate you set for your server's kit — adjust it to match how many pots players spawn with.
